code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/mha/download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper (life_status D + date_of_death memicu processPS RIP/RP2, TS-NRO untuk DoD masa depan), utilities/suspension_helpers/{PermanentSuspensionHelper,SuspensionBaseHelper} (PS tanpa revival date, stage NPA-CPC), framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (jalur DataHive FIN, dimatikan di prod), cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi: tidak ada jalur khusus untuk story ini
note: Story minta notice milik individu dengan life status tertentu (RIP = deceased) langsung disuspend sementara (temporary) dengan suspension code dan period tertentu agar tidak eskalasi. Code: hasil MHA (life_status D + date_of_death) membuat OCMS otomatis menerapkan suspension di job MHA Download yang sama, kode RIP (DoD pada/setelah offence) atau RP2 (DoD sebelum offence). Tetapi itu PS (permanent) tanpa revival date, bukan temporary dengan period; TS hanya dipakai untuk DoD di masa depan (TS-NRO). Status requirement: 'Requirement given - Gen flow' (flow umum, tidak ada flow deck OCMS). Jalur DataHive FIN (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false) mati di prod. Isi file MHA dan nilai property di server asli cannot verify from repo. Tiket: OCMS-DF-2026-135 (closed, PS dibatasi ke notice dalam batch) dan OCMS-DF-2026-177 (closed, offender indicator) mengubah cakupan step 1-2
recommendation: Klaim sebagian: identifikasi deceased dan penerapan suspension otomatis ada. Bagian 'temporary' dan 'period' tidak sesuai story (code memakai PS tanpa revival date); minta URA konfirmasi apakah PS-RIP/PS-RP2 boleh dianggap setara

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: OCMS mengenali individu dengan life status deceased dari hasil MHA
steps.detail: While processing the MHA result file, life_status is saved (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:730) and date_of_death is parsed and saved (:745-748). The suspension branch only runs when dod != null and life_status is 'D' (:873-874). The MHA Download job is enabled=true in prod, Mon-Sat 11:30, 16:30, 23:30 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120); the real server value cannot be verified from the repo. Scope is limited to the notice in the batch file (OCMS-DF-2026-135, closed), not all notices of the individual; a record without date_of_death is not handled. No role restriction because it is an automatic job.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: OCMS langsung menerapkan suspension setelah life status dikenali
steps.detail: The suspension is applied in the same loop that stores life_status (processPS is called at MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:1017-1024 for notices that are not batch-safe; the rest are applied through applyPsSuspensionGetApplied after the loop, :1566-1575). So 'immediately' means in the same MHA Download run, not real-time. A notice that already has another suspension or is paid goes through the per-notice processPS validation and can be rejected (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:160-163). The second path through DataHive FIN (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1572, :3285) is also off because cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52).

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: Suspension memakai code khusus untuk kasus deceased
steps.detail: A dedicated code exists: RIP when date_of_death is on/after the offence date, RP2 when before it (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:962-965; processPS with SuspensionReason.RIP at :1020; RIP/RP2 constants in SystemConstant.java:34-35). A future DoD uses TS-NRO (:890).

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.detail: The story asks for a temporary suspension. RIP/RP2 are applied through PermanentSuspensionHelper.processPS (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:1017-1022; PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:68), so suspension_type = PS (SystemConstant.SuspensionType.PERMANENT). TS is only used for a future DoD (TS-NRO, :890), not for the RIP/RP2 cases.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.detail: PS computes the revival date and it is always NULL ('Step 7: Calculate revival date (PS-specific) - Always NULL', PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:179-180), so a RIP/RP2 notice has no period and does not revive automatically. There is no period setting for the RIP/RP2 codes.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: Notice tidak eskalasi ke stage berikutnya
steps.detail: A RIP/RP2 suspension can only be applied at stages NPA, ROV, ENA, RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3, CPC; at CFC it is rejected (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:85-88, :210-214). A notice with a suspension is marked in VON, but the repo does not prove that every stage cron (reminder, DN, court) skips PS notices; only some were checked. So stopping escalation is only proven for applying the suspension, not for all crons.
